exact_examples.question: 1993年，Fremont 的书店比 Portland 的书店在图书销售数量上多出百分之多少？
exact_examples.query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.city = 'Fremont' THEN qty END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.city = 'Portland' THEN qty END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.city = 'Fremont' THEN qty END) FROM book_publishing_company.sales AS T1 INNER JOIN book_publishing_company.stores AS T2 ON T1.stor_id = T2.stor_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.ord_date) = '1993'
